description: This file defines an interface class 'WebAudioClientBackendInterface' for Web Audio client backend operations within the 'firebolt::rialto::client' namespace. It declares virtual methods for creating, destroying, controlling playback, buffer management, device info retrieval, and volume control related to Web Audio functionality.

classes.name: WebAudioClientBackendInterface
classes.description: An interface class defining Web Audio client backend operations, including creation, destruction, playback control, buffer management, device info, and volume control.

methods.name: createWebAudioBackend
methods.description: Creates a Web Audio backend with specified client, MIME type, priority, and configuration.

methods.name: setEos
methods.description: Sets the end of stream for Web Audio.

methods.name: getBufferAvailable
methods.description: Retrieves the number of available buffer frames.

methods.name: getBufferDelay
methods.description: Retrieves the buffer delay in frames.

methods.name: writeBuffer
methods.description: Writes data to the buffer with specified number of frames.

methods.name: getDeviceInfo
methods.description: Retrieves device info including preferred and maximum frames, and support for deferred play.
